expectation: Membrane/cell-surface ring on monocytes and macrophages (myeloid cells), a minority of cells, scattered or in clusters in the stroma and tumour-immune interface, absent from most tumour cells and empty areas.
observed: A: strong yellow cell-shaped networks in many ROIs, very uneven between ROIs, with dense patches in one ROI and little in others. B, C: sparse patchy yellow near nuclei. D: yellow rings and meshwork around dark-gapped blue nuclei.
why: Membrane-pattern signal on a patchy subset of cells that varies by ROI and region, not a uniform haze, edge glow or speckle.
notes: Yellow outlines cell borders around nuclei in D and forms myeloid-like clusters and networks in A. B and C are sparse, but the pattern is cellular and varies by region.
